metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD 2.7.0 Uninstaller (GTA V Legacy)
metadata.description:
Takes the GTA VI-Inspired HUD off GTA V LEGACY (GTA5.exe) again. Maintained by Geckomacabre. Install it with OpenIV, to the mods folder, the same way you installed the HUD. Game in C:\Program Files? Start OpenIV with right-click > Run as administrator.
Need help? discord.gg/C7gE5SHEzH, or a GitHub issue.
What it removes - The HUD's scripts: GTA6Hud, ViExtras, ViWasted, ViCustoms, ViCrouch, ViSwitch and ViMinimap, with their .ini files and the files in scripts\Hud, scripts\ViExtras, ViCustoms, ViCrouch and ViWasted - ViMinimap.asi, next to GTA5.exe - The packs vihud, vihudfonts and vihudanims (mods\update\x64\dlcpacks), and their lines in dlclist.xml Only the HUD's own files: it removes the files of every version up to this one, whichever you have, and nothing another mod also uses. Your other mods stay as they are.
What it leaves - Your progress, in scripts\Hud\Save. Coming back later? It's still there. If not, delete the scripts\Hud folder. - The HUD's logs (scripts\GTA6Hud.perf.log, scripts\ViExtras.log and the like, and ViMinimap.log next to GTA5.exe). You can delete them. - scripts\LemonUI.SHVDN3.dll, because other mods use it too. - scripts\MiniMap.settings, .levels, .heights and .water (about 30 MB): the standalone GTA VI MiniMap mod keeps its settings and map data in the same files. Don't have it? You can delete them. - The higher limits in gameconfig.xml. Other mods may need them, and they do no harm. - The VI loading screens, if you installed them. Your install guide's "Optional: VI loading screens" shows how to put the game's own back. - Script Hook V, Script Hook V .NET, OpenIV, and Jason or Lucia if you added them.
https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
metadata.licence: Personal use. Removes the GTA VI-Inspired HUD (by FBICat, maintained by Geckomacabre); it installs nothing.
